'''Halno'an''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who agreed to work with a group of mercenaries shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. He was young at the time, and his assistance was needed to rescue [[Shan'dira]] from her own clan.
